evidence: Two problems with the API model's requests, found before any Sonnet run, and the user's decisions on them (2026-10-24, relayed by the orchestrator). (1) Claude Sonnet 5.5 accepts only its default sampling values: a request carrying a temperature is answered with HTTP 400. Every request the harness would have sent carried one: client.js put `temperature` in every body, the model's own 0.2 (models.js TEMPERATURE) and, on the warmer retry after a looping reply, Math.max(Number(temperature) || 0, ANTI_REPEAT_TEMPERATURE) = 0.6 (provider/model.js providerModel). So no Sonnet run could have started. (2) Nothing bounded a cloud reply: the spend tracker reserved each request's worst case at MAX_REPLY_TOKENS (8,192 tokens of reply, spend.js), but runPolicy.js REPLY_CAPS.openai sent nothing, so a long reply (hidden thinking included, billed as output) could cost more than the tracker counted. The cache-read price in models.js was $0.10 per million tokens; the right figure is $0.20. The user's decisions, quoted: 'Raise to $20' (the Sonnet spend cap becomes $20, RMC's share of the cycle's $40 total staying at most $28; it was $12) and 'Fix both first': send no temperature to Sonnet 5.5 (null, matching the sibling project NEBULA's setting); cap each cloud reply at 8,192 tokens, the figure the tracker already assumes, sent as max_tokens so thinking counts within it; fix the cache-read price to $0.20 per million tokens. Checked on scripted fake servers only: the Sonnet request as sent and its body, first request and warmer retry, carry no temperature key and max_tokens 8192; the LM Studio and Ollama bodies are as before, byte for byte (keys, temperature 0.2 and 0.6 on the retry, no max_tokens, Ollama's num_predict uncapped); the model-visible snapshots and the record snapshots unchanged, the whole frontend suite passing; the context-budget pins unchanged (48k headroom 4,241 tokens for the dock and 7,044 for the validation's worst turn). Approved by the user, 2026-10-24.
proposed_fix: validation/models.js: the Sonnet entry sets capUSD 20, temperature null (none sent), maxTokens = spend.js MAX_REPLY_TOKENS (imported, not copied) and prices.cacheReadPerMTok 0.2; resolveModel keeps a model's own temperature (null included) and gives the others TEMPERATURE (0.2); the local models set neither, so their requests are unchanged. src/llm/provider/model.js providerModel (where provider quirks live, driven by the settings, never by the model's name, so the app's dock, which passes neither, is unchanged): temperature null puts no temperature key in the request as sent, the warmer retry included (the retry is still asked, unchanged); maxTokens, a positive integer (anything else a RangeError when the port is made, never dropped), goes into sent.maxTokens and, on Ollama, caps the plan's numPredict; the port hands the provider layer temperature null for a request with no temperature key. client.js builds the body from what it is given: a null temperature left out, max_tokens only when maxTokens is a number (never by default: OpenAI's newer models refuse max_tokens); ollama.js leaves a null temperature out of its options; contextGuard.js streamCopilotChat passes maxTokens to the OpenAI-compatible path. validation/runPolicy.js records what is sent: temperature { base: null, warmer_retry_min: null, sent: false } for a model that takes none (the others' shape unchanged), the reply cap through replyCapOf ({ sent: 'max_tokens', max_tokens: 8192, rule: 'max_tokens 8192 in every request (thinking counts within it)' } for a capped cloud model; REPLY_CAPS' LM Studio and Ollama rows unchanged), temperatureSummary for the report's column ('not sent (the model's default, the retry too)'); transcript.js says 'no temperature sent'. spend.js: the comments say the reserved reply is now the cap each request is sent with, so the worst case is a bound the provider enforces; its arithmetic is unchanged. PROTOCOL_VERSION 2026-10-24.6. Docs: docs/algorithms/copilot-validation.md (the run policy's temperature, reply_cap and spend rows, the Sonnet request policy, models and spend, the $20 cap), the llm README (the model port), AGENTS.md (provider/model.js), docs/AGENT_PLAN.md (the Sonnet share), the change fragment docs/changes/unreleased/sonnet-request-policy.md. Left open: the ledger's charge after each request counts the characters that streamed back, so thinking billed as output but returned with no text (Sonnet 5.5 thinks adaptively by default, its thinking text omitted) is not charged; each request's reservation is bounded by max_tokens, the ledger's total is not (said in spend.js and the doc; no arithmetic change, as decided). Whether Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint takes max_tokens and omits nothing else is not verifiable without a live call: max_tokens per the decision. Arms A and A+ do not send requests and were not re-run; the re-freeze waits for the parallel protocol change. Approved by the user, 2026-10-24.
